config.langueAide: Remembered by this browser. The page reloads in the chosen language; the world carries on and loses nothing. The journal, thoughts and narratives stay in French for now. To add a language, copy langues/en.json under another name (for example de.json) and translate it.
config.quotidienAide: Drinking, eating, sleeping, resting, looking for shelter, coming and going: unticked, these actions are no longer logged (neither the summary of the day nor the thoughts about them). Whatever involves others is always logged: watching over someone, sharing, healing, comforting, quarrelling… Entries already written are kept.
config.alertesAide: Disasters that threaten humans and sky phenomena are announced at the bottom of the screen. Unticked, they are no longer shown; the badge on the “Disasters” button still counts serious alerts, and pausing on alerts is set in the “Time” panel. This setting applies to this browser.
config.calculAide: One core: humans live each step one after another, as until version 0.22.0. Several cores: they live each step at the same time, spread over the cores; the story is not the same as with one core, but the same seed gives the same world whatever their number. The fastest depends on the machine and the number of humans: compare the speed reached. The change applies from the next step.
config.clemenceAide: The Entity's hand: the share of the risks of disease (epidemics included), infection, death in childbirth, death of children under 5 and death in disasters that it wards off. At 0%, the world as it is; at 100%, nobody dies of these causes any more. Hunger, thirst, cold, old age, wars and murders do not change. Each change is logged in the journal as an act of the Entity; it applies from the next step.
config.sauvegardesAide: A save keeps the whole world as it is at this moment. Restoring it replaces the current world, which is saved first too.
config.nouveauAide: These settings are stored in the database of the new world. A map tile measures 800 m: this resolution stays fixed, the map grows in number of tiles. Beyond 400 km per side, the simulation slows down.
